VIDEO SCRIPT: LISTENING AND SPEAKING 1.1.1 POLITE LANGUAGE: TELEPHONE ETIQUETTE
Grade: Grade 8 · Subject: ENGLISH

[0:00–0:20] HOOK
• Host: “Today we learn Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Polite Language: Telephone Etiquette. Watch the example, then you try.”

[0:20–2:00] TEACH
• Euphemism = softer polite wording.
• Polite language shows respect.
• Practise short oral forms: riddles, proverbs, polite requests.

[2:00–4:00] WORKED EXAMPLE ON SCREEN
• “passed away” instead of “died”
• “washroom” instead of blunt toilet talk in formal settings
• “Please may I…?” for polite requests

[4:00–5:00] TRY THIS (PAUSE)
• Write 5 direct sentences, then rewrite each with a euphemism / polite form.
• Role-play a market conversation using polite requests.
• Explain why polite language matters in school assemblies.

[5:00–5:30] REMEMBER + CTA
• Recap 3 bullets. “Now open Revision Quiz for Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Polite Language: Telephone Etiquette.”

— CBC Learn · Video Hub script aligned to lesson + revision
